title: Persistent PTY Multiplexing Daemon for Long-Running Agents
context: Decoupled terminal process execution across transient user interfaces and live reconnects.
distilled_learning: Multiplexing shell processes across a daemonized PTY background server prevents child process termination when UI clients detach, enabling resilient session recovery and live inspection.

claims.assertion: Multiplexing shell processes across a daemonized PTY background server prevents child process termination when UI clients detach, enabling resilient session recovery and live inspection.
